evidence_type_enum.description: gate-5 remediation fix (supersedes the gate-4 vocabulary): a CLAIM's own evidence type. 'official_guidance' = one authoritative agency states this directly (was wrongly folded into 'expert_consensus' before -- the exact defect this pass corrects: 'a single authoritative DNR source is official guidance, not expert consensus'). 'independently_corroborated' = this specific claim's derivation genuinely draws on >=2 sources from DIFFERENT organizations (checked by the import validator's areSourcesIndependent(), never by claim count alone). 'peer_review_supported' = a peer-reviewed journal article. 'manufacturer_guidance' = a manufacturer source -- valid ONLY for product specifications, never as evidence a manufacturer's technique is superior (enforced by the import validator, see validate-independence.mjs). 'expert_synthesis' = a reasoned, undersourced inference. 'anecdotal' = a single non-institutional/practitioner claim.

confidence_enum.description: gate-5 remediation fix (supersedes the gate-4 5-tier vocabulary): a TACTIC/PROVISION's overall confidence ceiling, ordered strongest-to-weakest. 'independently_corroborated' (renamed from the misused 'expert_consensus') requires >=2 claims from GENUINELY DIFFERENT organizations on the SAME decision-critical field -- same webpage/organization/parent organization/republished article does not qualify, checked programmatically, never asserted. 'official_guidance' sits BELOW independently_corroborated: a single authoritative agency (e.g. one MN DNR page) is real, citable evidence, but is not consensus. 'unsupported' means excluded from normal recommendation ranking.

readiness_enum.description: gate-5 addition: a tactic-level readiness gate, SEPARATE from confidence. Confidence describes how strong the evidence is FOR WHAT IS ACTUALLY SOURCED; readiness separately asks whether every decision-critical field is covered at all. A tactic cannot be ready_for_human_review while any decision-critical field (see the fixed list in pilot/decision-critical-fields.mjs) is still an unsupported_gap. Computed by the import validator, not hand-set.

evidence_status_enum.description: gate-4 remediation addition: separates WHAT KIND of evidence a claim is from the free-text evidence_type label that was previously doing double duty. 'externally_sourced' = a real, independently fetched/published source directly supports this exact field. 'derived_synthesis' = a reasoned combination of >=1 externally_sourced claims, never invented from nothing, carrying its own derivation_explanation and derived_from_claim_ids, confidence-capped by its weakest input. 'unsupported_gap' = an explicit, honest admission that no real evidence exists for this field -- it still occupies the field_path slot (so the gap is visible and trackable) but must NEVER count toward evidence coverage, confidence, ranking eligibility, or publication readiness. Replaces the gate-3 pattern where an auto-generated expert_synthesis claim silently counted as 'coverage'.

platform_enum.description: Access method ONLY. Exactly 7 values, used identically by applies_when.platform AND environment_applicability -- fixes the gate-2 mismatch (environment_applicability previously used a different 6-key vocabulary with 'kayak_canoe' merged and 'river' wrongly included as a platform).

dissolved_oxygen_status_enum.description: Anglers cannot directly measure DO. This is an inferred PROXY only -- populated from documented indicators (under-ice duration + snow cover, algae bloom presence, known winterkill-prone water) never a raw sensor reading. The proxy basis must be stated in the tactic/claim text wherever this field is used as anything other than unconstrained.

bait_component_enum.description: gate-4 remediation: the ATOMIC food/lure items a presentation actually puts in the water. Replaces the old bait_method_tag_enum's conflation of composition (live_bait/artificial_only/cut_bait/prepared_bait/fly) with method (trolling/still_fishing/casting/jigging).

bait_composition_mode_enum.description: gate-4 remediation: a single, mutually-exclusive declaration of what kind of presentation this is, replacing the old bait_method_tags array where a tactic could carry BOTH 'artificial_only' and 'live_bait' simultaneously with no way to tell which was authoritative for hard-filtering. 'hybrid_bait_and_artificial' is an honest, explicit third category (e.g. a jig that can be fished bare or minnow-tipped) -- it is NOT artificial_only-safe and a strict artificial_only user constraint must exclude it, since the recorded rigging still contemplates real bait.

presentation_method_enum.description: gate-4 remediation: the delivery METHOD, split out from bait_method_tag_enum's old composition/method conflation.

range.description: min<=max is NOT fully expressible in portable JSON Schema without a $data extension (ajv-specific, enabled in the validator config below); the companion validator AND the Postgres CHECK constraint in the DDL are the two independent enforcement layers that always run regardless of $data support.

condition_constraint.description: Wrapper for ONE axis inside a TACTIC's applies_when. Exactly one of three states, always present (never omitted) -- resolves the gate-2 contradiction where applies_when required every axis yet 'no constraint' meant omitting one. 'unconstrained' explicitly means the tactic works across the full range of this axis; 'not_applicable' means this axis has no meaning for this kind of tactic at all (e.g. current for a stillwater-only presentation). Only 'constrained' carries a value.

condition_observation.description: Wrapper for ONE axis inside a MISSION's observed_conditions. A DIFFERENT three states than condition_constraint -- mission-state concepts (missing vs. explicitly-unknown) never leak into a tactic record, and tactic-state concepts (unconstrained vs. not_applicable) never leak into a mission record.

condition_set.description: TACTIC-side condition envelope. Every axis key is REQUIRED (satisfies 'every axis present'); each value is a condition_constraint, whose OWN state field is what actually says constrained/unconstrained/not_applicable (satisfies 'no ambiguity about what omission means' -- nothing is ever truly omitted).

observed_conditions.description: MISSION-side observation envelope -- same axis names/vocab as condition_set, but wrapped in condition_observation (observed/unknown/missing), never condition_constraint. This is the schema requirement-3's 'mission-state concepts must not be stored as tactic constraints' resolves to: two schemas, shared enums, different wrappers, never mixed.

environment_applicability.description: Same 7-key platform vocabulary as applies_when.platform (fixed from gate 2's mismatched 6-key version). river is correctly absent -- river is a water_environment, not a platform.

user_constraint_tag_enum.description: The closed, controlled set of user-constraint tags a Mission request may pass. An unrecognized tag is a validation error (negative-tested below), never silently ignored.
